Impeccable writing and editing skills; extensive journalism experience, including at print magazines; excellent communication skills; ability to work under strict deadlines and adapt to changing priorities; ability to build and maintain good working relationships at all organizational levels and within the media; excellent judgment and discretion and ability to maintain strict confidentiality

Covered Individuals: A Covered Individual includes anyone designated as Personnel or Students under this Policy who physically access a University Facility or Program in connection with their employment, appointment, or education/training. A person accessing a Healthcare Location as a patient, or an art, athletics, entertainment, or other publicly accessible venue at a Location as a member of the public, is not a Covered Individual.
10+ years of excellent written, verbal, interpersonal communications, and active listening skills in higher education
Advanced judgment, analytical and decision-making skills and advanced political acumen.
